name: Narryer Metals Limited
summary: Narryer Metals Limited, an Australian explorer established in 2021 and headquartered in West Perth, looks for nickel, copper, platinum group elements, rare earth elements and gold. Its portfolio includes the Narryer projects, about 1,900 square kilometers around Mt Nairn and Mt Gould in Western Australia, and the Gawler Craton projects in South Australia.
